text:
This time, I created a character sheet for Vampirella and then a simple storyboard.

I uploaded both images to Seedance 2.0 and added this prompt:

15-second continuous single-shot. No cuts. No scene transitions.

Style: gothic animated fantasy, elegant vampire heroine, classic dark fantasy atmosphere, cinematic storybook animation, dramatic moonlight, towering gothic castle interiors, flowing cape animation, soft painterly textures, vintage European animation feel, expressive character acting, highly detailed gothic architecture, romantic horror mood.

Dark atmospheric ambience, distant wind through castle halls, fluttering bats, echoing cathedral space, soft cape movement, subtle candle crackling, gentle stone footsteps, cinematic tension. No vocals.

Reference the exact vampire heroine design from the character sheet: long black hair with bangs, pale skin, elegant red cape, white bodysuit, sharp expressive eyes, silver pendant necklace, stylized vintage animation proportions and expressions.

The sequence follows the exact progression and composition language of the storyboard panels.

0–3s 

Wide cinematic shot of the vampire heroine standing on a cliff overlooking a gigantic gothic castle beneath a full moon while bats circle the sky.

The camera slowly pushes toward her flowing cape as moonlight illuminates the valley below.

3–6s 

The camera glides through towering castle doors into a massive candlelit gothic hall.

The heroine cautiously steps inside, her cape trailing behind her while shadowy figures watch silently from the darkness.

6–9s 

The camera circles around her as she raises one hand dramatically, unleashing swirling supernatural energy while bats erupt around the cathedral ceiling.

Candles flicker violently and long shadows stretch across the stone floor.

9–12s 

The heroine discovers an ancient forbidden book inside a hidden library chamber.

The camera moves over her shoulder toward a massive portrait of a sinister vampire lord watching from the darkness with a faint smile.

12–15s 

The heroine suddenly turns toward camera and extends her hand forward as if casting a spell directly at the viewer.

The sequence ends with her standing triumphantly on a rooftop beneath the enormous full moon while bats spiral around the gothic skyline.

Final frame:

the vampire heroine silhouetted against the giant moon above the gothic city, cape flowing dramatically while swarms of bats circle through the night sky.
content:
Create a character sheet and a storyboard first, then upload both images to Seedance 2.0 to lock character design and shot progression.

Specify duration and continuity explicitly (e.g., 15-second continuous single-shot, no cuts, no scene transitions) to enforce an unbroken take.

Tell Seedance to reference the exact character design from the character sheet by listing defining traits (hair, skin, outfit, accessories, proportions/expressions) to maintain consistency.

Instruct the model to follow the exact progression and composition language of the storyboard panels to match your planned framing and beats.

Break the prompt into timestamped segments (e.g., 0–3s, 3–6s, 6–9s, 9–12s, 12–15s) with specific camera moves and actions to control pacing and choreography.

Add an explicit “Final frame” description to steer the ending composition and last image.

translations.es:
---
Crea una hoja de personaje y un guion gráfico primero, luego sube ambas imágenes a Seedance 2.0 para fijar el diseño del personaje y la progresión de las tomas.

Especifica la duración y la continuidad explícitamente (por ejemplo, toma continua de 15 segundos, sin cortes, sin transiciones de escena) para asegurar una toma ininterrumpida.

Indica a Seedance que haga referencia al diseño exacto del personaje de la hoja de personaje enumerando rasgos definitorios (cabello, piel, atuendo, accesorios, proporciones/expresiones) para mantener la consistencia.

Instruye al modelo para que siga el lenguaje exacto de progresión y composición de los paneles del guion gráfico para que coincida con tu encuadre y ritmos planeados.

Divide el prompt en segmentos con marcas de tiempo (por ejemplo, 0–3s, 3–6s, 6–9s, 9–12s, 12–15s) con movimientos de cámara y acciones específicas para controlar el ritmo y la coreografía.

Añade una descripción explícita del “Fotograma final” para guiar la composición final y la última imagen.
translations.fr:
---
Créez d'abord une fiche de personnage et un storyboard, puis téléchargez les deux images sur Seedance 2.0 pour verrouiller le design du personnage et la progression des plans.

Spécifiez la durée et la continuité de manière explicite (par exemple, plan-séquence continu de 15 secondes, sans coupures, sans transitions de scène) pour imposer une prise ininterrompue.

Demandez à Seedance de se référer au design exact du personnage à partir de la fiche de personnage en listant les traits distinctifs (cheveux, peau, tenue, accessoires, proportions/expressions) pour maintenir la cohérence.

Instruisez le modèle à suivre la progression exacte et le langage de composition des panneaux du storyboard pour correspondre à votre cadrage et rythme prévus.

Divisez le prompt en segments horodatés (par exemple, 0–3s, 3–6s, 6–9s, 9–12s, 12–15s) avec des mouvements de caméra et des actions spécifiques pour contrôler le rythme et la chorégraphie.

Ajoutez une description explicite de la “Final frame” pour orienter la composition finale et la dernière image.
---
translations.ja:
---
まずキャラクターシートとストーリーボードを作成し、両方の画像をSeedance 2.0にアップロードしてキャラクターデザインとショットの進行を固定します。

持続時間と連続性を明確に指定します（例：15秒の連続ワンショット、カットなし、シーン転換なし）ことで、途切れないテイクを実現します。

Seedanceに、キャラクターシートからの正確なキャラクターデザインを参照するように指示し、一貫性を保つために特徴的な要素（髪、肌、衣装、アクセサリー、プロポーション/表情）を列挙します。

モデルに、ストーリーボードのパネルの正確な進行と構成言語に従うように指示し、計画したフレーミングとビートに一致させます。

プロンプトをタイムスタンプ付きのセグメントに分けます（例：0–3秒、3–6秒、6–9秒、9–12秒、12–15秒）し、特定のカメラの動きとアクションを指定してペースと振り付けを制御します。

エンディングの構成と最後のイメージを導くために、明確な「Final frame」の説明を追加します。
---
translations.ko:
---
먼저 캐릭터 시트와 스토리보드를 작성한 후, 두 이미지를 Seedance 2.0에 업로드하여 캐릭터 디자인과 샷 진행을 고정하세요.

지속 시간과 연속성을 명확히 지정하세요 (예: 15초 연속 단일 샷, 컷 없음, 장면 전환 없음)하여 끊기지 않는 촬영을 강제하세요.

Seedance에게 캐릭터 시트에서 정확한 캐릭터 디자인을 참조하도록 지시하고, 일관성을 유지하기 위해 정의적인 특성(머리, 피부, 의상, 액세서리, 비율/표정)을 나열하세요.

모델에게 스토리보드 패널의 정확한 진행과 구성 언어를 따르도록 지시하여 계획한 프레이밍과 비트를 맞추세요.

프롬프트를 타임스탬프된 세그먼트(예: 0–3초, 3–6초, 6–9초, 9–12초, 12–15초)로 나누고, 특정 카메라 움직임과 동작을 추가하여 속도와 안무를 제어하세요.

마지막 구성과 최종 이미지를 조정하기 위해 명확한 "Final frame" 설명을 추가하세요.
---
translations.pt-BR:
---
Crie uma ficha de personagem e um storyboard primeiro, depois faça o upload de ambas as imagens para o Seedance 2.0 para fixar o design do personagem e a progressão das cenas.

Especifique a duração e a continuidade explicitamente (por exemplo, tomada única contínua de 15 segundos, sem cortes, sem transições de cena) para garantir uma tomada ininterrupta.

Diga ao Seedance para referenciar o design exato do personagem da ficha de personagem listando características definidoras (cabelo, pele, roupa, acessórios, proporções/expressões) para manter a consistência.

Instrua o modelo a seguir a progressão exata e a linguagem de composição dos painéis do storyboard para corresponder ao enquadramento e ritmo planejados.

Divida o prompt em segmentos com marcação de tempo (por exemplo, 0–3s, 3–6s, 6–9s, 9–12s, 12–15s) com movimentos de câmera e ações específicas para controlar o ritmo e a coreografia.

Adicione uma descrição explícita de “Quadro final” para direcionar a composição final e a última imagem.
translations.zh-CN:
首先创建一个角色表和一个故事板，然后将这两张图片上传到Seedance 2.0，以锁定角色设计和镜头进程。

明确指定时长和连续性（例如，15秒的连续单镜头，无剪切，无场景转换）以确保镜头的连贯性。

告诉Seedance通过列出定义特征（头发、皮肤、服装、配饰、比例/表情）来参考角色表中的确切角色设计，以保持一致性。

指示模型遵循故事板面板的确切进程和构图语言，以匹配您计划的构图和节奏。

将prompt分解为带有时间戳的片段（例如，0–3秒，3–6秒，6–9秒，9–12秒，12–15秒），并指定具体的摄像机移动和动作，以控制节奏和编排。

添加明确的“最终帧”描述，以引导结束构图和最后一张图像。
